answer_2.quote: We evaluate our methods by measuring the overall extraction system's performance on the test set using the maximum F1 averaged across all fields, denoted as "Average E2E Max F1" in ).

answer_4.quote: We acquired stats from our team of annotators on how long the classic annotation takes for various document types. We found it averaged 6-8 min for an annotator to label a single-page document with fewer than 20 fields while it averaged 10-30 min for an annotator to label a multi-page document with 25 fields.
answer_4.guideline: The classic annotation task is to draw a bounding box around each instance of any of the target fields and label it with the corresponding field name... we ask annotators to accept or reject a candidate extraction.
